headline: Self-production accounts for more than half of economic activity in the housing sector
summary: Self-construction and home improvement carried out by households represented 56.8% of the housing sector's economic activity in 2025. The figure is reported for Mexico.
why: The housing sector is a significant part of construction activity, and its composition shapes demand for building materials and credit.
original_headline: La autoproducción concentra más de la mitad de la actividad económica del sector vivienda
